prompt: This 'pure' function is not actually pure. Why?
choices: add() is not a valid method on List
The function modifies the caller's list (side effect) — it is not pure
Returning the same list is illegal
explanation: list.add(item) mutates the List passed in — a side effect that is visible to the caller. A pure version would return a new list: List<Integer> newList = new ArrayList<>(list); newList.add(item); return newList. The original list remains unchanged.
